VersionInfo.Title: Markdown Monster 4.5.2 is now available
VersionInfo.Detail: This update adds many enhancements: * Switched to Monaco Editor Platform * Support for inline Diffs * Minimap support * Razor, Http, Curl Syntax Highlighting editor and preview * Improved Preview Sync Performance * Editor/Preview Ratio now stays fixed * AI Summaries, Text Cleanup, Translation and Image Gen * plus [much more...](https://github.com/RickStrahl/MarkdownMonster/blob/main/Changelog.md)
